watches.name: THE SEA RANGER
watches.description: The Sea Ranger is our best watch yet! Built from 316L grade stainless steel, double domed sapphire crystal, a 12hr sapphire bezel, 30 ATM WR, a military time track and our very first bracelet. We built this watch to do anything and go anywhere from the field to the sea and anywhere in between. The 12hr bezel will give you a second time zone by a quick turn of the bezel and arguably the easiest way to a GMT. The case is an asymmetric shape and features lug holes for easy changing of straps/bracelets. Tool for the bracelet is included as well. Now Shipping! *International Orders - Buyer is responsible for any customs duties
